name: Atlantic hurricanes
summary: No tropical cyclones in the Atlantic; one low near Bermuda has a 20% chance of forming
state: The National Hurricane Center's outlook at 07:00 EST on 6 Nov showed no tropical cyclones in the Atlantic. A gale-force non-tropical low several hundred miles south of Bermuda had a 20% chance of formation over seven days and was not threatening land (NHC). The season ends on 30 Nov.
for_you: No action needed; check the National Hurricane Center before Caribbean travel.
rubric_hit: No storm threatening land within 5 days = Normal

sources.title: NOAA NHC — Graphical Tropical Weather Outlook

why: Atlantic hurricanes hit the US Gulf coast, Caribbean and Central America — and refinery and insurance markets with them.
drivers: Sea-surface temperatures, ENSO, wind shear, season timing (Jun–Nov peak Aug–Oct).

rubric.alert: Category 3+ landfall expected within 72 hours or occurring.
rubric.watch: Tropical storm or hurricane threatening land within 5 days.
rubric.normal: No hurricane active, or none threatening land within 5 days.
